original_card.question: Is there a genuinely unsearched, explicitly bounded improvement to the selected packing?
methods: Search a named unclaimed canonical candidate domain with a reproducible partition.
Prove a stronger scoped relaxation or exact optimum for one named residual subproblem.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Check live PR overlap first, price both suppliers and distinguish a search best from an optimum. Report the word's packing cap from ceiling.ceiling() and the fraction of it realized; label packing gains as such.

first_step.inspect: Locate the selected packing source in the review and check live PRs for the same residual problem.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Define an unclaimed canonical domain and a favorable bound before starting a new search.
original_card.bottleneck_link: An actual paid-profile gain can improve the frontier up to the other supplier cap.
allowed_variations: One bounded residual packing instance or exact relaxation.
If the coverage law, template or guard changes, derive an applicable fully charged replacement bound instead of applying the incumbent ceiling outside its scope.
scope_change_triggers: Rerunning an existing search with only a different seed as a separate mathematical contribution.

task_classification: Explicit coordinator assignment (joint retired-lender / lender assignment on our local retired5 words, every existing hosting movable), not a random card draw.
actual_scope: Extended retired-lender census on the retired5 words (PR2751 + five retired-lender aliases) treating every existing B-warp hosting as movable; two hostee moves (warps 30/31: 401->564, 403->565) with exact refits enable two more PR2679-type aliases 667<-401, 669<-403; certified frames; compacted owner fill; complete release through PR2751's own full replay.
scope_change_reason: No retired lender with frame floor <= 5 retires before the four remaining rank-4 followers enter, but 24 hosted lenders do once their hostees move to the two free floor-5 lenders 564/565, which retire before the hostees enter; an exact one-rank refit of those lenders' last gates makes the moves and two more aliases feasible.
bottleneck_link: Removing two more width-5 helpers per call frees 1332 hosted cells as idle 5-remainders while the certified frames merge jumps (local {1:-4,2:+6,3:-6}); the paid moment drops and the complex endpoint rises by 3.86e-7 over retired5 (6.53e-7 over PR2751, 5.38e-7 over PR2766/PR2767).
stop_rule: One explicit pair of hostee moves and two aliases on both providers after an exact augmenting-path census (192 paths, at most two extra aliases); no exhaustive search over other mechanisms claimed. Stop after complete release and handoff.
declared_milestone: Integrated conditional kappa, subject to the inherited all-size/interface/analytic assumptions.

obligation_ledger.native_words: Two new words; fresh five-stage native runs passed; PR2679/PR2751 and retired5 stage controls retained and the new refit7/hostmove2/alias7/refit7c stages carry their own tamper controls (retired7_controls.py).
obligation_ledger.physical_hosting: Complete literal owner fill (271728 roles, R 408) checked by reconstruct.py and the independent integer-chronology/bit-mask checker.
obligation_ledger.supplier_and_outer: Discovery/unpin/freeze, strict T74 replay and the package's own verify_release.py passed in the full cold release.
obligation_ledger.inherited: All universal obligations of PR2751 and its lineage are inherited unchanged.

family_expansion_decision: Explicit request to improve the latest pending construction; the retired-lender alias family (PR2679) is extended by an exact refit census on the new words, not reopened unchanged.
evidence: Full cold release (four fresh native providers, retained parent, complete admission, PASS_RELEASE) and registered hook (seven-stage rebuild, pinned PR2679 auditor on eight states, 142 tamper controls, literal owner fill, exact 1e-24 bracket, 80-digit root, kappa above PR2751, PR2766, PR2767). Evidence in evidence/retired7.
author: Marius-Paul Dumitrean (@mdumitrean)
ai_assistance: Substantial AI assistance (Anthropic Claude, via Claude Code) in the census, augmenting-path search, pricing, stage construction, checker adaptations, certification runs and documentation. No independent human review or formal theorem claimed.

open_questions.question: Can a gate-level (kernel) edit make the rank-1-entrance followers alias-feasible?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The 48 rank-1 followers are width-8 helpers (about 1e-6 relaxed value each), but every lender's exact frame floor is at least rank 4.
open_questions.first_step: Price single-gate kernel edits that lower one candidate lender's retirement frame floor below rank 2, with the auditor and native chain.
open_questions.blocked_by: No retired lender reaches rank <= 1 under any refit of the fixed gate lists.

open_questions.question: Can a third free floor-5 lender be opened for followers 670 and 671?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Each further width-5 alias of this kind priced about +1.9e-7 here.
open_questions.first_step: Search frame refits or gate moves that lower a free lender's floor to rank 5 with retirement before B941.
open_questions.blocked_by: Only 564 and 565 are free lenders with floor <= 5; both now host the moved warps.

open_questions.question: Do the retired5 and retired7 stages stack with PR2767's post-cut partner correction?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Both improve PR2751 independently; a stack could add their gains.
open_questions.first_step: Apply the seven stages to PR2767's words and re-run the census and the certified frames.
open_questions.blocked_by: PR2767's words differ from PR2751's; the stage inputs are word-specific.
